svg.text: Dual-Head Causal Model for Streaming Code-Switch Prediction
At token t, the model sees only x₁…xt​ and predicts the switch and duration for xt+1​
Input: one sequence, subword IDs from the backbone's own tokenizer
position t attends only to positions ≤ t
Padding mask is applied on top of the causal mask
One forward pass gives outputs for every position
Hidden state ht​ (768-d) at every position, then Dropout(0.1)
output: p_switch ∈ [0, 1]; switch if p_switch ≥ threshold
positions with a valid switch label (ysw​ ≠ −1)
Length bin of the new segment
only at switches with a known length (ydur​ ≠ −1)
Labels at [CLS], [SEP] and [PAD] are −1 and do not count in either loss.
Gradients from both losses update the shared backbone.
